On MuSiQue-Ans, the **C-only model gets about 3.4–3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1**. The exact answer score depends on the split:

- **Validation set:** 3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 4, p. 10). For comparison, the same model scores 18.4 / 67.6 on HotpotQA and 50.1 / 92.0 on 2WikiMultihopQA (p. 10).
- **Test set:** 3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 5, p. 11). The paper says Table 5 reports test-set numbers and everything else uses the validation set (p. 10).

The C-only model sees only the context, not the question (p. 10). The authors say that support identification on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA works surprisingly well without the question, but "fails on ♫-Ans" (p. 11).

On the stricter MuSiQue-Full variant, the C-only model scores 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf (Table 5, p. 11).
